agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
May 12, 2009
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Cantor Larry Kornit, Congregation B’Nai Tikvah
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Presentation of the Alta Vista Children’s Garden Name and Design Contest Winners.
P2.
Presentation on 211 San Diego by Chief Operating Officer Mona Freels.
P3.
Proclamation declaring May 15, 2009, "National Bike to Work Day" in the City of Vista.
P4.
Proclamation declaring May 17-23, 2009 "Public Works Week" in the City of Vista.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending March 31, 2009 (CC)
C4.
Sports Park Biological Mitigation and Monitoring Contract (CC)
C5.
Red Light Photo Enforcement Program Contract (CC)
C6.
Award of Auditing Services Contract (CC)
C7.
Amendment No. 4 for Traffic Engineering Consultant (CC)
C8.
Engineer's Reports and Assessments for Fiscal Year 2009/10 (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving an Engineer's Report on the City of Vista Lighting and Landscaping District No. 1 assessments for the 2009-2010 Fiscal Year and declaring its intent to levy and collect assessments;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , determining the cost of services and amount of assessment to be imposed on all assessable property within the City of Vista Street Maintenance District No. 1 for Fiscal Year 2009-2010 pursuant to the Benefit Assessment Act of 1982; and (Recommended Action continued on following page)
(Recommended Action continued from previous page)
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving an Engineer's Report on the South Melrose Landscape Maintenance District assessments for the 2009-2010 Fiscal Year and declaring its intent to levy and collect assessments.
C9.
Collection of Delinquent Mandatory Trash Charges for 2008/09 (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , declaring its intent to set a Public Hearing for collection of delinquent solid waste charges; and
2.
Set June 23, 2009, as the date of the public hearing to levy assessments on the 2009/10 property tax roll for collection of delinquent 2009/09 mandatory trash charges.
C10.
San Diego Association of Governments (SANDAG) FY 2010 Transportation Development Act & TransNet Bicycle & Pedestrian Projects - Call for Projects (CC)
C11.
As-Needed Environmental and Permitting Consultant Agreements (CC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving an agreement with Merkel & Associates, Inc., for environmental and permitting consulting services;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving an agreement with Jones & Stokes Associates, Inc., for environmental and permitting consulting services;
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving a reimbursement agreement with City of Vista and Buena Sanitation District for as-needed environmental consulting costs (Merkel & Associates, Inc.);
4.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving a reimbursement agreement with City of Vista and Buena Sanitation District for as-needed environmental consulting costs (Jones & Stokes Associates, Inc.); (Recommended Action continued on following page)
5.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2009- , approving a reimbursement agreement with City of Vista and Buena Sanitation District for as-needed environmental consulting costs (Merkel & Associates, Inc.); and
6.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2009- , approving a reimbursement agreement with City of Vista and Buena Sanitation District for as-needed environmental consulting costs (Jones & Stokes Associates, Inc.) ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
C12.
Fiscal Harships Resulting from State Actions
DISCUSSION
D1.
Fire Station No. 1 Design/Build Services (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , amending the Capital Improvement Program for FY 2008-2009; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving the agreement with Erickson-Hall Construction Co. for design/build services for Vista Fire Station No. 1, and authorizing the Mayor to execute the amendment.
D2.
2009-2014 Consolidated Plan and 2009/2010 Annual Action Plan (CC)
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Ambulance Transport Service Fee Increase (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony, close the public hearing; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , amending ambulance transport fees.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
